source_conventions.work: Ptolemy Tetrabiblos III.13–14 On the Quality of the Soul
source_conventions.attests: mind and reason (Mercury), sensory/affective soul (Moon), philosophical and religious dispositions in natal interpretation
source_conventions.limitation: Interpretive convention, not proven ability to predict participant scores.

source_conventions.work: William Lilly Christian Astrology I, Ninth House description (1647/1659)
source_conventions.attests: religion/clergy, dreams, visions, books, learning, long travel as ninth-house subjects
source_conventions.limitation: House topic list in introductory/horary material, not a prevalidated quantified natal measurement.

source_conventions.work: Lilly Christian Astrology Book III: Nativities, chapters on Ninth House
source_conventions.attests: Book III includes natal judgements on ninth-house journeys and religion (contents)
source_conventions.limitation: Full natal rule-level evidence and direct predictive direction not yet extracted here.

source_conventions.work: Meaning in Life Questionnaire source study
source_conventions.attests: distinct presence of meaning vs search for meaning
source_conventions.limitation: External psychological construct, not an astrological natal rule.

interpretation_policy.chart_domain_claim: Historical chart convention is not empirical predictive validity.
interpretation_policy.survey_coverage: Direct means a V7 question asks the relevant behavioral construct, not that astrology successfully predicts it.
interpretation_policy.cross_systems: AstroHD reduced six-rule lunar/Jupiter/Saturn profile is separate from canonical HD V4.3 and from classical natal astrology.
interpretation_policy.prediction: No new chart mapping may be fit from same participant after responses; freeze on independent people first.
interpretation_policy.instrument_safety: Some chart topics are sensitive life outcomes and should not be smuggled into a routine personality questionnaire.

matrix.measurement: Beliefs, shifts in worldview, personal practice separate from intensity of supernatural conviction
Frequency and intensity of awe; specific awe is a modern experiential extrapolation rather than an explicit classical natal item
Surprise about one's own thoughts/actions versus about world/other people
Sudden lived realization, deep revision, impact on behavior; V7 only tests planning/problem understanding and life-phase changes
Felt predictability of one's life and episodes of abrupt self-revision
Noticing coincidences, assigning meaning, later appraisal; historical dreams/visions do NOT directly assert synchronicity frequency
Frequency and conviction in a sense of being guided; neutral to divine/nondivine interpretation; classical source is indirect
Dream recall, vivid dreams, dream-meaning interpretations separate from literal predictive claims
Meaning in ordinary life, felt purpose; V7 G16 asks worth of one volunteer project, not global meaning
Difference between wish to matter and perceived actual impact on others/world
Real-world epistemic methods captured; broader philosophy and fascination not directly measured
How one enters roles and responds to recognition; not status life history
Relationship behaviors under situational constraints
Attraction, ongoing closeness and physical-affection preferences
Moral responses to dilemmas partially sampled, not complete value commitments
Work sustainability/project choices do not show actual occupation, vocational calling or ambitions
Preference and use of resources measured; actual wealth events and long-term economic change not
Creative behavior, taste, art engagement and aesthetic sensitivity not measured by social planning scenes
Home/family belonging, attitudes to relatives and identity over upbringing; sensitive history not compulsory
Optional actual life events and caregiving values, not forced hypothetical parenthood or speculative medical prediction
Trip planning scene is not longitudinal travel, exploration, or foreign-cultural interest
Background emotion/social recovery sampled; atypical mood not comprehensively covered
Work-related energy and room sensitivity sampled; no biomedical predictions justified
A subset of reactions to ordinary uncertainty/strain, not life trauma history
Changes in choices and routines, not verified timelines, external events, or predictive historical dates
Sensitive event/medical domain; historical tradition's claim is not a safe diagnosis or predictive instrument

coverage_notes.not_full_astrological_corpus: This is a first source-anchored atlas over representative classic natal and house meanings; not yet every chapter or Jyotish/Hellenistic rule.
coverage_notes.owner_gap: Need chapter-level inventory from all retained Lilly, Dariot, Ptolemy, Hellenistic and Jyotish texts, each bound to native feature/rule and testable outcome; no target-aware tuning.
coverage_notes.pre_registration: Future scoring work must have owner-independent source feature mapping and controls before responses, not add points based on compelling case stories.
